fomod.Name: Sleep in Bed SKSE - Chinese Localization / 多语言语言包
fomod.Author: zhuabaobao123 (translation)
fomod.Description: Optional interface language files for Sleep in Bed SKSE. Installs one SleepInBedSKSE.json into SKSE\Plugins; the plugin loads it at runtime. Includes the localized DLL and a Chinese-annotated INI in the core files. Deleting SleepInBedSKSE.json reverts the interface to English. Languages: English, Русский, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español, 简体中文.
